D.t: Kweisi Mfume leads by 75.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 227,520 votes; a one point swing is about 1,515 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +70.8 and D +79.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
